proof_scope_audit: All probabilities are physical teaching inputs; no risk-neutral valuation or empirical frequency is silently inferred. Selection is evaluated over all tested applicants and does not imply full repayment or funded bank settlement.

Cash-prefix sufficiency holds only for the fixed stated receipts, payments and permitted actions, with no additional interest, rollover, asset sale or early collateral release. The contribution is not repaid within the tested horizon. The minimum in Q2 is proved, not inferred from a numerical search.

The duplicate transfer creates an asset worth three and a loss of two; its gross five and retained unpaid five are distinct claims. Full stress totals use compatible rows before maximizing, and revaluation does not become cash.

Insurance utility inversion has nonnegative square-root arguments. Participation assumes full performance, which is verified from fresh per-policy capital plus premium; no insolvent-pool participation or missing equilibrium theorem is used.

Auction proceeds equal uniform price times quantity, not an integrated marginal-price curve. The admissible interval and minimum-sale policy select the quantity; the entire feasible set is disclosed. Buyer, lender, retained collateral and private support inventories are separately accounted for.

The funded intervention meets a specified finite-state principal-loss limit only after actual escrow. Contractual interest shortfall differs from principal loss. Scope excludes a general systemic equilibrium, universal welfare optimum or real legal authority.
